_meta.purpose: Define the schema and RED fixture contract for importing, signing, caching, and replaying security evidence inside sovereign/air-gapped cells without live external egress or scanner/CLI authority.
_meta.claim_boundary: Schema and fixture contract only. This artifact does not implement mirror services, network policy, scanner execution, admission webhooks, product APIs, certified cells, or air-gap operating readiness.

source_authorities.role: Accepted air-gap environment substitution, no-egress, in-cell registry/KMS/observability, and sovereign pack current-state input.
Supply-chain security baseline for signed SBOMs, vulnerability scanning input, and artifact admission evidence.
Authoring ADR anchor referenced by the sovereign cloud air-gapped canonical spec.
Private KMS/HSM/OpenBao binding anchor referenced by the sovereign cloud air-gapped canonical spec.
Existing supply-chain kernel concepts for SBOM, provenance, vulnerability, and admission evidence; scanner output remains input data only.

non_claims: No external advisory feed freshness is claimed after an offline bundle leaves the connected staging side; consumers must evaluate the signed cursor age and fail closed when stale.
No scanner CLI, local shell command, GitHub/Jenkins workflow, hosted dashboard, or human spreadsheet becomes security or merge authority through this contract.
No live egress, mirror service, admission webhook, policy engine, trust portal, or runtime API is implemented by this artifact.
No production, certification, FedRAMP/ITAR/BSI/SecNumCloud/ACN/KR-FSC, or air-gap readiness claim follows from this planning contract alone.

canonical_surface.rule: Air-gapped cells consume only locally present signed mirror indexes, sync-bundle manifests, offline evidence packets, no-egress proof records, private trust bindings, and cached admission decisions. External scanner/feed bytes are untrusted input until normalized on the connected side and signed into a deterministic sync bundle.

airgap_evidence_flow.output: signed advisory/SBOM/VEX/provenance source snapshots with trusted timestamps and cursor positions
fail_closed_if: source signature or trusted fetch receipt missing
candidate input tries to weaken feed list

airgap_evidence_flow.output: normalized mirror indexes keyed by artifact digest, component PURL, vulnerability id, and source revision
fail_closed_if: SBOM, VEX, or provenance cannot be joined to the artifact digest

airgap_evidence_flow.output: content-addressed sync bundle manifest with sorted entries, Merkle root, previous bundle digest, and HSM-backed signature
import receipt recorded inside the air-gapped cell with media identity, operator identity, and bundle digest
local PKI/KMS/HSM binding proves the cell verifies signatures and protects signing/decryption keys without external KMS
fail_closed_if: root CA fingerprint or HSM key id missing

airgap_evidence_flow.output: network-policy, service-mesh, DNS, NTP, and admission evidence proving decisions do not require external egress
fail_closed_if: external ServiceEntry or broad egress is present

airgap_evidence_flow.output: bounded packet for auditors/admission containing mirror freshness, SBOM/VEX/provenance refs, trust binding, and no-egress proof
fail_closed_if: packet omits any required evidence ref

airgap_evidence_flow.output: portable signed admission verdict with input digests, policy bundle version, expiration, and replay guard
fail_closed_if: decision input digest cannot be reproduced
decision is replayed after high-water mark

advisory_feed_mirror_snapshot.v1.freshness_rule: trusted_now - source_retrieved_at_trusted must be <= maximum_age_hours, with cisa-kev evaluated at the tighter emergency cadence.

sbom_mirror_index.v1.admission_rule: Every artifact referenced by an offline admission decision must have signed SPDX and CycloneDX refs plus a provenance attestation; VEX cannot compensate for a missing SBOM.

vex_mirror_index.v1.expiry_rule: Expired VEX statements revert to blocking under_investigation until a newer signed VEX or fixed artifact exists.

provenance_mirror_index.v1.admission_rule: Portable cached decisions must bind to provenance refs; missing provenance blocks promotion/admission.

determinism_rules: Entries are sorted by record_type, artifact_digest, component_purl, vulnerability_id, then source cursor.
All timestamps used for expiry are trusted producer timestamps, not candidate-supplied wall clock values.
manifest_digest is computed over canonical JSON with UTF-8, sorted object keys, and no insignificant whitespace.
sequence_number must be strictly greater than the last accepted bundle for the target cell and pack.
content_rules: Bundle entries may include source URLs as provenance data but admission evaluation inside an air-gapped cell must not dereference them.
Every included index ref must be content-addressed and signed or covered by the bundle manifest signature.
Bundle valid_until_trusted cannot exceed the earliest required feed freshness expiry unless an explicit emergency hold state blocks admission.

offline_evidence_packet_contract.claim_ceiling_rule: claim_ceiling must remain contract_only, planning_only, or evidence_packet_for_review until runtime implementation and independent review produce separate proof.

no_egress_proof_contract.pass_rule: admission_path_external_fetches must be false, egress_exception_refs must be empty or explicitly non-admission and expired-deny, and DNS/NTP/OCSP/CRL evidence must point to in-cell services.

portable_cached_admission_decision_contr.portability_rule: A cached decision is portable only with all input digests and the policy bundle version needed to reproduce it offline; it must expire no later than the earliest feed/VEX/provenance freshness limit that influenced the decision.

freshness_and_expiry_policy.trusted_time_source: in-cell chrony or offline ceremony timestamp bound to the import receipt; candidate packets cannot provide their own trusted_now.
freshness_and_expiry_policy.mirror_stale_behavior: Any required feed snapshot older than its maximum_age_hours blocks allow verdicts and turns cached decisions into hold_for_review or block per policy.
freshness_and_expiry_policy.vex_expiry_behavior: Expired VEX statements are ignored for allow decisions and produce expired_vex_block until refreshed or the artifact is fixed.
freshness_and_expiry_policy.sbom_missing_behavior: Missing signed SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM blocks admission and cannot be waived by VEX, scanner output, or manual assertion.
freshness_and_expiry_policy.kev_emergency_behavior: A new or active KEV match for an artifact/component invalidates existing allow cache entries unless a newer signed bundle contains fixed/not_affected evidence with security review approval.
freshness_and_expiry_policy.offline_replay_behavior: Bundle and decision sequence numbers must be monotonic per cell/pack and nonce values must be single-use; replay or rollback attempts block even when signatures verify.

fail_closed_rules.blocks_when: any required advisory feed snapshot exceeds maximum_age_hours at trusted evaluation time
a vulnerability match depends on a VEX statement whose expires_at_trusted is before trusted_now
artifact lacks signed SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM refs
KEV feed newer than the cached allow decision marks a matched vulnerability as known exploited without a newer fixed/not_affected decision
bundle or decision sequence regresses, nonce is reused, or previous_bundle_digest does not match the high-water mark
